landing.title: Your server, next level
landing.subtitle: The bot your server needs. Moderation, welcomes, levels, reaction roles and much more — all from a powerful dashboard.
landing.featuresDesc: Modular plugins you activate with a click from the dashboard
landing.moderationDesc: Ban, kick, warns, message cleanup. Everything you need to keep your server in order.
landing.welcomesDesc: Customizable welcome and farewell messages and cards with dynamic variables.
landing.levelsDesc: Complete leveling system to reward the most active members of your community.
landing.reactionRolesDesc: Let your members assign themselves roles by simply reacting to a message.
landing.starboardDesc: Highlight the best messages in the server on a channel when they receive enough reactions.
landing.webDashboardDesc: Configure absolutely everything from the web. Zero commands, maximum visual control.

dashboard.selectDesc: Choose the server you want to configure

guild.pluginsDesc: Enable or disable modules for your server. Click Configure to adjust each one.
guild.unlockFeatures: Unlock levels, starboard, logs and more.
guild.welcomeDesc: Send custom messages when someone joins or leaves. Includes welcome card.
guild.autoroleDesc: Automatically assign roles to new members when they join the server.
guild.moderationDesc: Keep your server safe with ban, kick, warn and message cleanup commands.
guild.reactionRolesDesc: Let your members get roles by reacting to a specific message.
guild.logsDesc: Log moderation actions and server events in a dedicated channel.
guild.ticketsDesc: Support system with tickets. Users open tickets from a panel with a button.
guild.suggestionsDesc: Let members submit suggestions and vote on them with reactions.
guild.levelsDesc: XP and leveling system to reward the most active members.
guild.starboardDesc: Highlight the most popular messages in a channel when they receive enough reactions.

welcome.title: Welcomes & Farewells
welcome.desc: Configure the messages, cards and roles applied when someone joins or leaves the server.
welcome.welcomeMessageDesc: Sent when a user joins the server
welcome.dmDesc: Send a DM to the user when they join
welcome.dmPlaceholder: Hi {user}! Welcome to {server}. Read the rules to get started.
welcome.formatDesc: Choose how the welcome message is displayed in the channel
welcome.embedDesc: A Discord embed with the welcome message, avatar and custom color.
welcome.cardDesc: A custom image with avatar, name and background of your choice.
welcome.cardSettingsDesc: Customize the appearance of your welcome card
welcome.bgImageHint: Paste an image URL (Imgur links are detected). Recommended: 800x300 px.
welcome.cardChannelHint: If left empty, sent in the welcome channel.
welcome.autoroleDesc: Automatically assign a role when a user joins the server
welcome.autoroleHint: This role will be automatically given to each new member.
welcome.farewellDesc: Sent when a user leaves the server

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.desc: Configure the moderation tools and the server's auto-moderator.
moderation.modRoleHint: Users with Discord permissions can always moderate.
moderation.automodDesc: The auto moderator is composed of the modules below. You can enable and disable them. You can also configure the actions the bot will perform when certain conditions are met.
moderation.ignoreBots: The Auto Moderator ignores and does not affect other bots
moderation.autoActionsDesc: This allows the auto moderator to mute, kick, ban, temp-mute, or temp-ban automatically.
moderation.warnThresholdHint: Number of warns needed to execute the automatic action.
moderation.durationDesc: Only applies for mute and temporary ban. 0 = permanent.

levels.title: Levels
levels.desc: XP and leveling system to reward the most active members.
levels.systemDesc: Members earn XP by sending messages
levels.visualCardDesc: Image with avatar, level, XP and ranking position.
levels.channelHint: Where the level-up message is sent
levels.levelMsgHint: Variables: {user} {level}. Only applies in text mode.

logs.title: Logs
logs.desc: Log moderation actions and server events in a dedicated channel.
logs.systemDesc: Moderation actions will be logged automatically
logs.channelHint: All moderation actions (ban, kick, warn, clear) will be logged here.
logs.eventsDesc: Logged events: bans, kicks, warns, message cleanup, role changes and automatic moderation actions.

starboard.title: Starboard
starboard.desc: Highlight the most popular messages in your server on a special channel.
starboard.systemDesc: Messages with enough reactions are published automatically
starboard.channelHint: Highlighted messages will be published in this channel.
starboard.emojiHint: The emoji users must use to highlight a message.
starboard.thresholdHint: Minimum number of reactions to publish on the starboard.

reactionRoles.title: Reaction Roles
reactionRoles.desc: Let your members assign themselves roles by reacting to a message.
reactionRoles.systemDesc: Create emoji + role combinations on a specific message
reactionRoles.messageIdHint: Right-click a message and select "Copy Message ID" (developer mode required).
reactionRoles.emojiHint: Use a standard emoji or the name of a custom emoji.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.desc: Support system with tickets. Users open tickets from a panel with a button.
tickets.systemDesc: Configure the category, support role and limits
tickets.categoryHint: Ticket channels will be created inside this category
tickets.supportRoleHint: This role will have access to all tickets and will be mentioned when one opens
tickets.logHint: Openings, closures and transcripts will be logged
tickets.maxHint: How many tickets a user can have open at the same time
tickets.panelDesc: Customize the embed and button published in a channel to open tickets
tickets.panelChannelHint: The channel where the panel with the "Open ticket" button will be published
tickets.embedDescPlaceholder: Click the button below to open a support ticket.
tickets.previewDesc: This is how the panel will look on Discord
tickets.welcomeMsgDesc: Sent inside the ticket when it's opened
tickets.openMsgPlaceholder: Hi {user}! A team member will assist you soon.
tickets.closeMsgDesc: Sent when a ticket is closed

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.desc: Let members submit suggestions and vote on them with reactions.
suggestions.systemDesc: Members can submit suggestions with the /suggest command
suggestions.channelHint: Suggestions will be published as embeds in this channel
suggestions.anonymousDesc: Does not show who submitted the suggestion
suggestions.resolutionDesc: When an admin approves or denies a suggestion, it moves to these channels
suggestions.approvedHint: Accepted suggestions will be forwarded here
suggestions.deniedHint: Rejected suggestions will be forwarded here
suggestions.votingDesc: Automatically added to each suggestion for members to vote
suggestions.previewDesc: This is how a suggestion will look on Discord
suggestions.previewText: Add a memes channel to share funny content.

premium.title: Upgrade your server
premium.desc: Unlock all premium features of kerybot for your community
premium.freeDesc: This server has no active premium. Some features are limited.
premium.cancelConfirm: Are you sure you want to cancel your subscription? You'll keep premium until the end of the current period.
premium.paymentSuccess: Payment completed! Premium will activate in a few seconds.

config.title: Configuration
config.desc: General settings for the bot in this server.
config.languageDesc: Set the language for bot responses in this server.
config.languageHint: Bot messages, embeds and notifications will use this language.
config.profileDesc: Customize the bot's appearance in this server.
config.premiumRequiredDesc: Upgrade to Premium to customize the bot's nickname and avatar for this server.
config.nicknameHint: The bot's display name in this server. Leave empty for default.
config.avatarHint: A direct image URL for the bot's server avatar. Leave empty for default.
config.previewAboutText: Your server's bot, configured from the dashboard.
